name: Disguise Self
summary: For 1 hour you and your gear look however you like, within limits; touch reveals the illusion.
text: For 1 hour you change how you look, along with your clothing, armor, weapons and everything else you carry. You can appear up to 1 foot shorter or taller and look heavier or lighter, but the new form must have the same basic arrangement of limbs as you; beyond that the look is your choice. The illusion doesn't hold up to physical contact: objects pass through any added details and a touch feels nothing there. A creature that takes the Study action to examine you sees through the disguise if it succeeds on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.
